decisions.reason: It is close to the firm’s established finishing portfolio, so the firm has the related knowledge to learn from early market feedback and improve it in a growing market.

As a UV spot varnishing system it is relatively distant from the firm’s core postpress strengths, and with no clear evidence of own R&D or research ties the firm is less able to absorb learning and justify continuing a weaker-fit product despite its flagship positioning.

The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm’s existing know-how in print-finishing workflow, which makes commercial learning and integration into its broad offer comparatively straightforward.
This multifinisher is close to the core business and was highlighted as a strategic focus, so it strongly matches the firm’s knowledge base and direction toward automated connected finishing.
A hybrid saddle stitcher fits well with the firm’s established booklet-making and binding capabilities, giving management confidence that it can support, refine, and sell the product.
The folding add-on is very near the firm’s existing competencies and already shows an installed-use reference, which lowers uncertainty and supports retention.
